messages.subject: Combining multiple legends
parts:
Hi,

I have a plot with a line and some intervals around it which I¹d like to
generate a suitable legend for.

Using dummy factors to map the colour of the line and fill of the ribbon
to aesthetics, I can get two legends, but I¹d like to make them look a bit
nicer together, as if they were one.

Here is some made up data:

DF <- structure(list(x = 1:10, y = c(0, 0.693147180559945,
1.09861228866811,
1.38629436111989, 1.6094379124341, 1.79175946922805, 1.94591014905531,
2.07944154167984, 2.19722457733622, 2.30258509299405), yl = c(0,
0.554517744447956, 0.878889830934488, 1.10903548889591, 1.28755032994728,
1.43340757538244, 1.55672811924425, 1.66355323334387, 1.75777966186898,
1.84206807439524), yu = c(0, 0.831776616671934, 1.31833474640173,
1.66355323334387, 1.93132549492092, 2.15011136307367, 2.33509217886638,
2.4953298500158, 2.63666949280346, 2.76310211159285), dum.line =
structure(c(1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L), .Label = "X", class = "factor"),
dum.hpd = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L,
1L), .Label = "HPD", class = "factor")), .Names = c("x",
"y", "yl", "yu", "dum.line", "dum.hpd"), row.names = c(NA, -10L
), class = "data.frame")


My basic plot is then made with:

xmpl<-ggplot(DF)+
geom_ribbon(aes(x=x,ymin=yl,ymax=yu,fill=dum.hpd))+
geom_line(aes(x=x,y=y,colour=dum.line))+
scale_fill_manual(values='pink')+
scale_colour_manual(values="blue")

I can then play around with the theme and can get to this stage quite
easily:

xmpl+theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
legend.position=c(0,1),
legend.justification=c(0,1),
legend.box.just="left")

Which has removed the separate titles for the two legends, positioned them
in the top left corner where there is loads of space and aligned the two
legends. But there are still two legends. I would like to make them look
more like a single legend by (a) bringing the two legends closer to each
other (adjusting the vertical spacing) and (b) giving them a single
background box.

Thanks in advance.

Ron.
